evidence: Independent scalar Fortran source parity at synthetic specified air states. No archived-column identity, population agreement or empirical validation.
reading_rule: Source functions and literals are retained unchanged, including unsuffixed default-real constants and the v_crit>0 capacitance decision. Air density uses the source ideal moist-gas expression at explicit T,p,pv; no grid interpolation or cloud-water repartition is tested. The habit-prediction stub is a fail-fast guard for an excluded branch and is never called. No supply cap is applied.
